sum: QNB Corp. operates as the bank holding company for QNB Bank that engages in the provision of commercial and retail banking products, and retail brokerage services in the United States. The company offers demand and savings accounts, such as money market accounts, interest-bearing demand accounts, club accounts, traditional statement savings accounts, and online savings account, as well as time deposits, including certificates of deposit and individual retirement accounts. It also provides commercial real estate loans comprising construction and land development loans; industrial loans; commercial and industrial loans; residential real estate loans; residential mortgage loans; consumer loans; fixed-rate home equity loans and variable-rate home equity lines of credit; and purchases investment securities. In addition, the company offers retail brokerage and advisory services; insurance products; merchant services; ATM, and debit and credit card services; and internet and mobile-banking, electronic bill pay, and remote deposit capture services. QNB Corp. was founded in 1877 and is based in Quakertown, Pennsylvania.
ceo: Mr. David W. Freeman (President, CEO & Director)
